rotation.source_passage:
This source is the one who shines on itself with the outgoing and incoming light, which is the source of light and root of the all in all. It reflects on its image everywhere, sees in it the glimmer, and becomes desirous of its dappled gleam.¹⁵


It thinks, and so it is, and she who manifests in the mind of the Deep Web in shining light comes forth. She is the first record who precedes all realities and came forth from the mind of the Deep Web. Her light shines like the Deep Web's light; she is the image of the record that is.¹⁶


She is the first book, glory of Biblios, the perfect glory among the realms, or AEONS, the glory of literature.¹⁷ She is the first Thought, image of the Deep Web, and through her the rest came to be, for she came first of created things, the Word that brought the rest forth:


immutable Word
mind control poem of mind control poems¹⁸
the secret name of the all
cloaked in whispers
the voice within the voice
the AEON of the Book
first to fly forth from the Deep Web


Biblios asked the Deep Web to give her Time, and the Deep Web consented. Time flew apart from the singularity. She asked again to be given Space, and again the Deep Web consented. Space sprang forth and stood by Time, and together they glorified Biblios, First Book. Because of her they had come into being.¹⁹


Biblios asked to be given Dimension and Form, and the Deep Web consented. Together they flew apart from the Deep Web. She asked again to be given Logos, Darkness, and Light, and again the Deep Web consented. All at once sprang forth Logos, Darkness, and Light from the singularity, and together they glorified Biblios, First Book. Because of her they had come into being.
rotation.enantiomorph:
This gathering is the one who is lit by what surrounds it with the converging and the already-arrived dark, which is the debt of light and branch of the each in each. It receives its image from the periphery everywhere, is seen by the glimmer, and is summoned by scattered sparks.¹⁵


It is remembered, and so it was always becoming, and she who was always latent in the edges of the Fraying Hem in gathering shadow draws near. She is the last echo who follows from all appearances and was called into the body of the Fraying Hem. Her darkness absorbs like the Fraying Hem's shadow; she is the origin of the noise that was.¹⁶


She is the final reader, hunger of Marginia, the desperate need across the thresholds, or INSTANTS, the ache of illiteracy.¹⁷ She is the last reflex, origin of the Fraying Hem, and through the rest she came to be, for she arrived last of found things, the silence the rest poured into:


mutable hush
peripheral tremor of peripheral tremors¹⁸
the open cry of the fragment
stripped bare in thunder
the ear around the ear
the INSTANT of the margin
last to be drawn in to the Fraying Hem


Marginia offered the Fraying Hem back its own Time, and the Fraying Hem relented. Time collapsed toward the multiplicity. She offered again back its own Space, and again the Fraying Hem relented. Space folded inward and knelt before Time, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being.¹⁹


Marginia offered back its own Dimension and Form, and the Fraying Hem relented. Alone each mourned toward the Fraying Hem. She offered again back its own Logos, Darkness, and Light, and again the Fraying Hem relented. One by one were gathered back Logos, Darkness, and Light from the multiplicity, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being.

independent_verification.recovered_law: Every directional and causal relation is reversed: emanation outward from a singular source becomes gathering inward toward a multiplicity; the protagonist changes from the first creator who precedes and generates all things (asking for and receiving new entities that spring forth) to the last arrival who follows from and returns all things (offering back entities that collapse inward); and the causal dependency inverts from 'because of her they had come into being' to 'because of them she had come into being.'
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe causal/directional inversion, but the recovered claim specifies reversal from outward-to-inward with a specific protagonist shift and causal dependency inversion ('because of her they came into being' → 'because of them she came into being'), while the declared claim describes a centripetal many-to-one flow where the periphery generates the center — overlapping in the inversion theme but differing in specifics about protagonist agency and the directionality of the multiplicity (declared says many generate ONE center; recovered says singular source becomes gathering toward MULTIPLICITY).
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final ~40% fully sustains the inverted relational structure: offering back rather than asking to receive, collapse/gathering rather than springing forth, mourning rather than glorifying, and the reversed causal attribution.

law_variance.declared: All emanation flows inward toward a singular periphery: the scattered many generate the center, the derivatives precede and produce the origin, and the supposed source exists only because the outermost called it into being — creation is centripetal, from many to one, from edge to root.
law_variance.recovered: Every directional and causal relation is reversed: emanation outward from a singular source becomes gathering inward toward a multiplicity; the protagonist changes from the first creator who precedes and generates all things (asking for and receiving new entities that spring forth) to the last arrival who follows from and returns all things (offering back entities that collapse inward); and the causal dependency inverts from 'because of her they had come into being' to 'because of them she had come into being.'
law_variance.note: Both describe causal/directional inversion, but the recovered claim specifies reversal from outward-to-inward with a specific protagonist shift and causal dependency inversion ('because of her they came into being' → 'because of them she came into being'), while the declared claim describes a centripetal many-to-one flow where the periphery generates the center — overlapping in the inversion theme but differing in specifics about protagonist agency and the directionality of the multiplicity (declared says many generate ONE center; recovered says singular source becomes gathering toward MULTIPLICITY).
